No data loaded

Upload the CSV exported from the UEM dashboard (Computer Name, Installed Applications, OS, IP Address, CPU, Last Report Time). Nothing is uploaded to a server.
View Scope
Default is Overall. Optionally filter the complete dashboard by DISCOM or Zone. The UPPCL office hierarchy is also shown as DISCOM → Zone → Circle → Division → SDO.
Overall view — all systems in the uploaded file

EDR deployment readiness

Before rolling out EDR: how many endpoints already run antivirus, which ones already have an EDR next to it, and where games or other unwanted software are installed.

Software Category Distribution

Number of systems having at least one product in each category.

Operating System Distribution

Systems per OS family – editions, builds and service packs are merged.

Most Installed Software

Systems having each software – all versions counted as one.

Software Inventory Summary

Co-installed software check

Pick a software (default: Trend Micro Apex One) and see what else is installed on the same systems – another antivirus, an EDR, any security software, or everything.

Software Comparison

Compare any mix of software, categories and groups. Example: Any antivirus vs Cylance OPTICS vs Any game.

Check against a reference product

Pick a reference (default Trend Micro Apex One) and check all software, a group, a category or one software against it: which systems have both, and which have the software but not the reference.

Antivirus + EDR — UPPCL Office Hierarchy

DISCOM → Zone → Circle → Division → SDO

Hierarchy is mapped from the UPPCL office-code master embedded in this dashboard. The tree below defaults to systems having both Antivirus and the organisation-defined Trend Micro EDR. Cylance PROTECT is treated as a special antivirus product and can be included or excluded from the Antivirus calculation using the checkbox above. Counts are calculated at every hierarchy level from the uploaded AV + EDR endpoint data. Use the switch to view all managed systems.

Unrecognised software

Software the built-in database has no rule for. Download the list, fill in the category column, and it can be added to the database in the next version.
Dashboard runs locally in the browser. Uploaded files are processed in the browser and are not sent to a server by this page.
